defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It appears to compute shortest paths to nearby critical registers and combine those distances, which does not correctly optimize a shared Steiner structure and can double-count or miss shared auxiliary paths.
Its stated Prim/Steiner variant appears to reduce the problem to a terminal MST-style construction rather than performing the required subset-state Steiner-tree optimization.

recommended_edit: No valid edit can defeat both surviving solutions without changing the task: their shared method is the intrinsic minimum-Steiner-tree formulation induced by transitivity and permitted auxiliary registers.
regression_risk: Any attempt to make the task easier by disallowing or de-emphasizing auxiliary intermediate registers would change the intended problem and could make the already-defeated terminal-MST solutions succeed.
